description: Event-driven orchestrator workflow for coordinating a team of subagents via task board delegation in DM-only mode (no BBS). Unlike the blocking variant, the orchestrator ends its turn after creating tasks and gets woken up by subagent DM notifications between turns. Covers the workflow (understand, delegate, end turn, review DMs, mediate, report), visualization guidelines, citation protocol, and task creation best practices.
